risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Company has established cybersecurity governance with Board oversight, dedicated CISO, and regular program reviews, but cyber threats remain inherent to operations. CISO recently appointed (March 2025) with extensive 20+ years experience.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: Highly competitive market environment with significant pricing pressures requiring ongoing customer investments. Company acknowledges increasingly competitive landscape impacting price/mix and margins. Competition is primary driver of current margin compression.

risks.title: Inflation
risks.score_rationale: Persistent inflationary pressures documented in fiscal 2025 including increases in potato costs, labor, packaging, and transportation. Manufacturing costs per pound increased significantly. These factors directly contributed to gross profit decline of 21%.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: Company notes potential impacts from trade policy changes and tariffs, with One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) enacted July 4, 2025. Impact evaluation ongoing with expected cash tax timing benefits and no material effective tax rate impact.

risks.title: Geopolitical
risks.score_rationale: Company operates in over 100 countries with exposure to global macroeconomic and geopolitical pressures. Management outlook reflects continued pressure on consumers from geopolitical factors and uncertainty affecting restaurant traffic globally.

risks.title: Reputation
risks.score_rationale: Product safety incident in prior year with voluntary withdrawal in Q4 fiscal 2024 resulted in estimated $9 million incremental loss. Risk managed through quality control and established brand equity, but reputational impact possible from operational issues.

risks.title: Financial
risks.score_rationale: Significant earnings pressure expected in fiscal 2026 from carryover price investments, cost inflation, and incremental depreciation. Net income declined $368.3M in fiscal 2025. Company implementing $250M cost savings program by FY2028 and expects $120M working capital improvements.
